meta.name: shadcn
meta.description: Manages shadcn components and projects — adding, searching, fixing, debugging, styling, and composing UI, including chat interfaces. Provides project context, component docs, and usage examples. Applies when working with shadcn/ui, component registries, presets, --preset codes, or any project with a components.json file. Also triggers for "shadcn init", "create an app with --preset", or "switch to --preset".

copy.tagline: 管理 shadcn 组件和项目，添加、搜索、修复、调试和组合 UI
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果使用 shadcn/ui 构建 React 界面，需要管理组件和项目配置
copy.tagline_en: Manage shadcn components and projects: add, search, fix, debug, and compose UI
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build React UIs with shadcn/ui and need to manage components and project config

howto.what: 它会用 npx shadcn@latest 等命令管理项目里的 shadcn 组件：添加、搜索、初始化、切换预设；先读取项目配置和已装组件，再按官方文档和代码规则生成或修正组件代码（含聊天界面）。
howto.when: 当你说到“shadcn”、组件注册表、components.json 等，或要求“shadcn init”、用 --preset 创建/切换项目时触发。

say.text: 帮我添加一个对话框组件，先查一下文档。
say.note: 会先运行 docs 获取文档再添加。

say.text: 用预设码 abc123 初始化一个新项目。
把这个项目切换到另一个预设，先对比一下。
say.note: 会先 resolve 并询问覆盖/合并方式。

howto.what_en: Manages shadcn components via CLI (npx shadcn@latest): add, search, init, switch presets. Reads project config first, then writes/fixes component code (incl. chat UI) per docs and rules.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention shadcn/ui, component registries, components.json, or ask for 'shadcn init', create/switch with --preset.

say_en.text: Add a dialog component, check docs first.
Init a new project with preset abc123.
Switch this project to another preset, compare first.
